title: Tree BFS: level by level
summary: Node values grouped by depth, left to right. Read len(queue) once at the start of each pass, so the inner loop handles exactly one level. O(n). The TreeNode class is shown, not typed.
code: # Read len(queue) once per pass, so each pass handles exactly one level.
triggers: per-level answers in a tree: each level's values, average, maximum or rightmost node
the shallowest node, or the minimum depth, that meets a condition
prompts: An org chart is a binary tree. Print everyone grouped by how many levels below the CEO they sit, left to right within each row.
A knockout tournament is stored as a binary tree with the final at the root. List the matches round by round, starting from the final.
invariant: At the start of each pass, queue holds exactly the nodes of one level, in left-to-right order.
mantra: Freeze the queue length: one pass, one level.
pitfalls: Read len(queue) once before the inner loop; the loop appends the next level as it goes.
popleft(), not pop(): a stack mixes levels and order.
Handle an empty tree before seeding the queue.

anchors.name: Binary Tree Right Side View
